title: Seahorse Assay for Measuring Oxygen Consumption Rate in iPSC-Derived Neurons
author: Tzu-Chieh Huang
materials: Normalize oxygen consumption rates to total protein content.

steps.title: Seed and Differentiate Neurons
steps.instruction: Seed Day 5 iPSC-derived glutamatergic neurons (iGLUTs) into a XF24 microplate and differentiate until Day 21.

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Assay
steps.instruction: Prepare the cells by replacing the majority of the culture medium with pre-warmed Seahorse XF DMEM.

substeps.instruction: Remove most of the culture medium, leaving only 50 µL per well.
Add 1000 µL pre-warmed Seahorse XF DMEM supplemented with 25mM glucose and 0.23mM pyruvate.

steps.title: Incubate Plate
steps.instruction: Incubate the Seahorse plate at 37 °C in a non-CO2 incubator for 1 hour.

steps.title: Replace Assay Medium
steps.instruction: Replace the assay medium with 500 µL of fresh assay medium for the Seahorse assay.

steps.title: Measure Oxygen Consumption Rate
steps.instruction: Measure the plate using a Seahorse XFe24 Analyzer following the standard Mito Stress Test program.

substeps.instruction: Inject a mixture of 0.5 µM rotenone and 0.5 µM antimycin A.

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Lyse the cells using M-PER™ Mammalian Protein Extraction Reagent according to the manufacturer's instructions.

substeps.instruction: Add 30 µL of M-PER™ containing cOmplete™ Mini Protease Inhibitor Cocktail and PhosSTOP™.

steps.title: Measure Protein Concentration
steps.instruction: Measure total protein concentration using Pierce™ Dilution-Free™ Rapid Gold BCA Protein Assay.
